title: 🚨 Not every “national issue” going viral deserves your anger.
paragraphs: 🚨 Not every “national issue” going viral deserves your anger.

Every week may bagong issue.
Every week may bagong galit.
Every week may bagong dahilan para mag-away ang mga Kristiyano.

Some viral issues are not designed to inform you.
They’re designed to provoke you.

Rage-bait works like this:
1️⃣ Emotional headline
2️⃣ Cropped video clip
3️⃣ One-sided framing
4️⃣ Comment section war
And suddenly… believers are fighting believers.

Mga kapatid, we must ask:
Are we defending truth —
or are we reacting to manipulation?

The enemy doesn’t always attack the church from the outside.
Sometimes he just keeps us distracted.

Before you comment in anger, ask:
• Full context ba ito?
• Verified source ba ito?
• Or am I being emotionally steered?
Christians should be known for wisdom, not reaction speed.
📖 “Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to become angry.” — James 1:19

Don’t let algorithms disciple you.
Let the Word shape your response.
